analysis.reasonEn: Despite a sharp 14.80% drop after the previous buy signal (RSI 40.5), RSI remains in oversold territory with CCI showing an extreme bounce at -126.3. The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, suggesting potential for a new higher low formation. While ADX at 16.2 indicates a weak trend, a technical bounce is targeted for this 3x leveraged product. Stop loss set at 1.5x ATR ($113.00).
